{{Quote|A vast assembly of mercenary and pirate arms, vehicles, and personnel was gathered on Darvannis, ostensibly to vie for Cartel contracts. Instead, the Dread Master known as Styrak attempted to overwhelm and convert the mercenaries into service among the Dread Host|Jedi Master Gnost-Dural|<ref name="Record">{{TORweb|url=info/news/blog/20130913|text=A Record of the Dread Masters}}</ref>}}
A '''battle''' was fought on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Darvannis]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], when the [[Dread Masters|Dread Master]] [[Styrak]] attempted to assemble an army of [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] and other criminals. Posing as the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]], Styrak gathered powerful criminals, including the [[Warlord/Legends|warlords]] [[Horic]], [[Vilus Garr|Vilus]], [[Sunder (mercenary)|Sunder]], and [[Tu'chuk]], but was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by a strike team sent by one of the galactic powers to investigate the buildup on Darvannis.

==Behind the scenes==
The battle of Darvannis is a 8-16 players operation in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]'', released as part of Game Update 2.0: Scum and Villainy on [[April 9]], [[2013]].<ref name="TOR-update">{{TORweb|url=gameupdates/2.0-scum-and-villainy|text=Scum and Villainy}}</ref>
